a12dfbc3b86c2129.g: Finish the tutorial raid by extracting via the "Klimov Street" extraction which is located behind the "Skyside" business center. During the tutorial, numerous hints on controls and game mechanics are displayed, but none of them need to be followed in order to complete the raid.

bd0c3e829b585405.g: Visit Therapist in the menu through the trader screen and hand over 250,000 Roubles when the dialogue option appears.

deb0b59b9467840e.g: Laboratory manager's office (O21) on the second level.

39068a2374f994e7.g: Next to the hangar on the first level.

a4f11f8e00ac2091.g: In the basement at the "Sewage Conduit" extraction. The extraction does not need to be activated for this objective. You do not need to survive the raid.

36e2352c28e3905f.g: Extract from Interchange with either the "Survived" or "Run-Through" extraction status, or visit the location 3 times.

ab8ecc1edd006015.g: Extract from Customs with either the "Survived" or "Run-Through" extraction status, or visit the location 3 times.

30736dab25b42311.g: Extract from Factory with either the "Survived" or "Run-Through" extraction status, or visit the location 3 times.

dc526ed0aa9895d1.g: Kill any 3 targets on Woods and extract with either the "Survived" or "Run-Through" extraction status, or visit the location 3 times. The kills don't need to be performed in the same raid as the "survive" objective.

5c8796a39af2cdb3.g: To complete the next few objectives you have to go to the south-east corner of Shoreline and interact with the intercom at the watchtower in front of the Terminal. Be careful not to get too close to the Terminal wall, as there are guards that will shoot at anyone. Do not try to kill them, they return fire with deadly precision. Interacting with the intercom too many times after being told to leave will also lead to your death by the guards.

sh.c: Watchtower where the intercom is located

761d069ab3239450.g: Extract from Shoreline with either the "Survived" or "Run-Through" extraction status, or visit the location 3 times. Afterwards visit Prapor in the menu through the trader screen and hand over 5 Dogtags when the dialogue option appears. The Dogtags can be obtained by taking them off dead PMCs (they do not have to be killed by your hand).

7c7a10fc0d02091f.g: Visit Mechanic in the menu through the trader screen and hand over 20,000 Dollars when the dialogue option appears. Dollars can be purchased from Peacekeeper with Roubles.

71fc3066141fbe7e.g: One of the following two transits has to be used to access The Lab:

0beafe3c9cf734fc.g: Underground entrance in front of the Klimova 16A building with the Cosmonaut painting. TerraGroup Labs access keycard required. Transits are only available 1 min after raid start.

59c7db67d4648a03.g: In the sewer tunnel connected to the flooded area in the underground. TerraGroup Labs access keycard required. Transits are only available 1 min after raid start.
